title: Feature toggle KPI lockdown + kill-switch protocol
body:
Purpose:
This doc defines the operational protocol for flipping a major feature toggle (user-visible path A -> B) with an emphasis on: 1) clear KPI targets to unlock incremental cohorts, 2) a deterministic kill-switch and rollback procedure, and 3) an abbreviated nightly runbook for on-call and PMs.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to any rollout that changes inference routing (model variant, quantized/new kernel, or traffic split >10%).
- Small cohort probes (<1% traffic) follow the lightweight checklist in the ProdOps quicksheet — this expands that for staged flips up to 100%.
- Infra and SRE will maintain the kill-switch endpoint and automated traffic reversion tooling.

Pre-launch KPIs (what we measure before moving to next cohort):
- Latency (p50/p95/p99, server-only): target p95 <= 250ms for feature cohort.
- Error rate (5xx + runtime retrials): <= 0.5% sustained over 10m window.
- Cost delta per request (tokens normalized): < 15% uplift vs baseline.
- Quality checks (synthetic eval): pass rate >= 95% on golden prompt set.
- Adoption signals: successful completion rate for end-to-end journeys >= 98%.

KPI tracker (copy into sheet for live tracking). Columns: cohort, start_time, end_time, traffic_pct, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, error_rate_pct, cost_delta_pct, quality_pass_pct, owner, notes
Example row:
- cohort-1, 2025-01-20T09:00Z, 2025-01-20T10:00Z, 1, 120, 210, 380, 0.12, 3.7, 98.6, Diego Ramos, initial probe
- cohort-2, 2025-01-22T09:00Z, 2025-01-22T12:00Z, 5, 130, 230, 400, 0.28, 5.4, 97.2, Mark Liu, stable so far

Readiness checklist (must be green before cohort advance):
[ ] Infra: dedicated rollback endpoint tested (url + auth) - owner: SRE
[ ] Observability: Datadog dashboards and alert thresholds provisioned - owner: Observability eng (Mark Liu)
[ ] Evals: golden prompt suite run with new model config - owner: Applied ML (Sana Iqbal)
[ ] Rate limits/quota: API gates set for cohort - owner: Product-ops (Aisha)
[ ] Feature flag gating: server-side flag with kill-switch route - owner: Backend eng
[ ] Stakeholders notified: Slack channel and on-call list confirmed - owner: PM
[ ] Canary tests (synthetic users): smoke tests pass - owner: QA

Kill-switch and rollback protocol (ordered steps):
1) Leader (on-call SRE or PM) calls the launch channel and marks action: "KILL-SWITCH ENGAGED". Use Slack shortcut /kill-switch to create paging incident.
2) Trigger automated revert: POST to /internal/flag/revert with cohort id (this is idempotent). If automation fails, manual revert via admin console: revert traffic routing to baseline (0% to new variant).
3) In parallel, set a temporary quota at the ingress layer to 0.1 RPS for cohort users to throttle impact.
4) Confirm revert with monitoring: p95 drops below target or error rate normalizes; if not, escalate to infra lead and reimage nodes.
5) After revert, collect incident artifacts: data dump, traces, recent logs (last 30m), and attach to PROJ-4521.
6) Do not re-open cohorts until a postmortem itemizes root cause and fixes are validated.

Operational thresholds that auto-trigger an incident (any of these sustained for 5 minutes unless noted):
- error_rate_pct > 1.0% sustained 5m
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline sustained 10m
- quality_pass_pct < 90% on golden suite after cohort start
- cost_delta_pct > 30% sustained 15m (finance checkpoint)

Monitoring queries (starter examples):
- Datadog: avg:http.server.request.duration{service:inference,feature:toggleX}.rollup(300) by {quantile}
- Logs: count(status:5xx) by 1m for cohort tag
- Traces: tail of longest 10 traces for errors in last 10m

Night-of-launch runbook (for first 24h):
T-60m: final sync call (5–10m), confirm owners on call and Slack.
T+0–1h: live monitoring in launch channel, deploy a dedicated dashboard link.
T+1–6h: hourly pulses: PM posts summary w/ KPI snapshot.
T+6–24h: three checks (06h, 12h, 24h) and start cadence for next cohort decision.

Roll-forward decision matrix (advance if ALL true):
- latency/p95 within target for last 30m
- error rate < 0.5% over 30m
- golden eval pass rate >= 95%
- no new critical bugs on backlog
If any condition fails, hold cohort and run remediation runbook.

Postmortem minimum (if kill-switch engaged):
- Who flipped the flag + timestamp
- Timeline of metrics crossing thresholds
- Root cause hypothesis and remediations (owner + ETA)
- Follow-up validation plan and sign-off by Applied ML and SRE

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide whether to include model-quantization-specific metrics (KV cache hit ratio) in the tracker — owner: Applied ML (Sana).
- Validate automated revert POST endpoint with chaos test — owner: Infra (Diego).
- Add finance alert to PagerDuty for cost_delta_pct spike > 30% — owner: Finance eng.

Notes to self (working):
- Keep cohort windows odd hours in US time for first 48h to reduce retail impact.
- Consider adding a canary that uses heavy-context prompts to stress tokenizer and KV cache.

Appendix: quick checklist for small probes (<1%):
- Sanity smoke, run golden suite, monitor p95/p99, taste test 10 sessions, wait 60m, expand to 5% if stable.

Contact list (people to ping on the channel):
- Aisha Patel (product-ops) — aisha@redwood.ai
- Diego Ramos (infra) — diego@redwood.ai
- Mark Liu (observability) — mark@redwood.ai
- Sana Iqbal (applied-ml) — sana@redwood.ai

Last notes: this is intentionally prescriptive—use as checklist and paste key KPI rows into the canonical product-ops tracker before flipping. Update golden suite names when new evaluation sets are added.
